text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sustained GPU queue growth on cluster-gamma (>900 requests queued, avg wait 18s). Autoscaler attempted 2 scale events in the last 10m but reports failed allocations. Priority: P1. Triggered paging to SRE oncall.

Alice (SRE oncall): saw this spike — confirming customer-facing errors? I'm on it, will start triage.

Jamie Li: I’m pulling scheduler logs and MIG allocation traces. Initial look: a bunch of nodes with small MIG slices (1g.5gb) that don't match requested flavors (we're requesting 2g.10gb). Looks like binpack fragmentation.

Marcus Chen: Indeed — autoscaler creates pods sized for model-x-large which requires full 2g slices, but most free memory is in 1g slices so placement fails. Autoscaler retries but hits scale limit (max_replicas=8 for nodepool-gamma).

Priya Patel: Customer telemetry shows increased 429s and 5xx on hosted API routes for a subset of tenants (high-usage embedder workloads). CS is seeing inbound tickets. Dana, can you confirm impacted customers?

Dana (CS Escalations): Yes — two mid-market customers reporting latency spikes and timeouts (~30% of their requests failing). Escalation opened. Asking for ETA.

Alice (SRE oncall): mitigation plan: (1) temporarily lift nodepool-gamma max_replicas to 16, (2) trigger emergency binpack rebalance, (3) apply fast fallback policy to route new requests to cpu-fallback endpoints at lower QoS for non-auth customers. Any objections?

Noah (eng-runtime): lifting max_replicas approved. I'm pushing a hotfix to autoscaler policy to relax strict slice matching for 10m to allow mixed-MIG placements (best-effort) — this should allow packing pods across nodes with mixed small slices. Deploying now.

Jamie Li: pushing nodepool scale via cloud CLI: 
```
# increase replica cap
cloudctl nodepool update nodepool-gamma --max-replicas 16
# force scale to desired 12 for now
cloudctl nodepool scale nodepool-gamma --replicas 12
```

incident-bot: Scale request accepted, cloud API returns async operation id: op-83a9. Estimated node provisioning 2-6m.

Marcus Chen: while nodes are provisioning, we have ~900 queued requests. I'm enabling aggressive preemption of background low-priority jobs and prewarming 2 dedicated nodes with 2g slices for critical model-x-large.

Priya Patel: CS — telling impacted customers: "We're seeing GPU capacity pressure due to fragmentation. We're scaling and applying temporary fallbacks; expect reduced errors within ~10 minutes." Going to send a status message.

Dana (CS Escalations): Sent v1 status to customers. Requesting postmortem items: root cause, ETA, and mitigation.

Noah (eng-runtime): hotfix to autoscaler landed at +120s. It flips `allow_mismatched_slices=true` for 10m window and enables best-effort packing. Also reducing requested `min_available_gpus` on model-x-large pods from 2 -> 1 for canary traffic to reduce strictness.

Jamie Li: logs show some allocations immediately succeeding — a few pods scheduled on nodes with mixed slices. Queue dropped to ~420. RTT for successful requests down to 2.1s.

Alice (SRE oncall): good. Keep monitoring. We still have some stranded capacity: several nodes have free 1g slices that can't be used for remaining 2g requests. Planning manual repack: drain a couple of nodes with small-slice-heavy usage, migrate pods to newly provisioned nodes with proper 2g slices. I'll coordinate the repack and safe drain.

Marcus Chen: starting node drains now in controlled batches of 1 node at a time to avoid large eviction storms. Using `drain --grace-period=60s` and `pod-disruption-budget` exceptions for internal infra only.

incident-bot: Node scale operation op-83a9 completed. 6 new nodes provisioned (4x 2g slices, 2x mixed).

Jamie Li: repack in progress — moving 18 critical pods to 2g nodes. No additional errors yet. Queue is down to ~90.

Dana (CS Escalations): customers acknowledging reduced errors. One customer requested a retention of logs for the incident. Filing ticket.

Noah (eng-runtime): after repack, I'm reverting the temporary `allow_mismatched_slices` flag and restoring min_available_gpus back to 2 for model-x-large. Will keep canaries at 1 for 5 more min to observe.

Alice (SRE oncall): status update: impact mitigated; queue stabilized and latencies trending back to baseline. Next steps: postmortem, tighten autoscaler tests for mixed-MIG scenarios, update default nodepool sizing policy, and consider a new fallback routing for high-concurrency embedder tenants. Handoff to Marcus for follow-up.

Marcus Chen: taking 8h action items: reproduce with synthetic workload, add autoscaler unit test for slice mismatch, and propose GA change to nodepool image that prefers uniform MIG sizing.

Priya Patel: CS will send final incident summary to customers once we have ETA for permanent fixes.

Alice (SRE oncall): handing off to Marcus for long running remediation. Paging cleared. :white_check_mark:

Noah (eng-runtime): quick note for postmortem: include scheduler logs around `Bind` failures, autoscaler decision logs, and cloud provider allocation errors (`InsufficientCapacity`). Also include the workaround commands we ran.

Dana (CS Escalations): collecting CS timeline and customer impact metrics.

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved -> mitigated. Duration: 00:28:05. Postmortem required.
